We need produce candidate ST and save candidate.json. Must use compile_st, simulate_st, verify_st. Need think carefully about semantics.

We need infer interface: FB_Task with VAR_INPUT Start, Stop, Fault, Reset BOOL; VAR_OUTPUT Run, Locked BOOL, Attempts USINT. Internal mode enum IDLE/RUNNING/WAIT/LOCKED, free_scans 0..2. Need define DUT for enum maybe supporting object. Need exact names? Requirement says internal state mode IDLE/RUNNING/WAIT/LOCKED, Attempts 0..2, free_scans 0..2. We can name enum E_Mode maybe. Must define referenced DUTs. The verifier probably expects certain variable names? Atomic propositions qLocked uses reference state, not candidate. Verifier specification internally supplied likely matches task; candidate only needs visible outputs and behavior. Keep interface exact. Interface says outputs Run Locked Attempts. Internal can be mode etc. Need perhaps expose state? No.

Need design priority: valid reset > latched lockout > stop > running fault > recovery dwell > idle start. Important order. Conditions validReset = Reset & !Fault & !Start. If already LOCKED, remain LOCKED "Else Stop..." So valid reset must be able to clear locked because priority 1. Req 2 valid reset clears mode etc. Req 3 "If already LOCKED, remain LOCKED. Else Stop..." Ambiguous: priority says valid reset first means valid reset clears lock. Likely yes. LTL P4 says G((qLocked & !validReset) -> (Locked & !Run)). So lock only cleared by validReset. Priority 1 reset means validReset overrides lock. Req 3 "If already LOCKED, remain LOCKED." probably under else valid reset? Let's parse: 2 valid reset clears. 3 If already LOCKED, remain LOCKED. Else Stop = TRUE forces... So yes if not valid reset, locked remains. Priority ordering resolves.

Stop forces IDLE free_scans 0 preserving Attempts. Does stop also force in WAIT? yes priority before running fault etc. Stop doesn't clear lock if locked. validReset even if stop? validReset requires Start false; Reset true Fault false Start false; Stop may be true. Priority valid reset first. Fine.

In RUNNING: Fault true -> if Attempts>=2 LOCKED else WAIT free=0. But LTL P1 G(Fault -> !Run). Outputs match post transition, so at fault scan Run false. Good.

WAIT: if Fault clear free; else increment and when free_scans>=2, Attempts +=1 clear free go RUNNING. Need think free_scans pre-state and threshold. Requirement says increment then when >=2 retry. Atomic retryDue = qWait & !Fault & free>=1. If pre free=1, increment to 2, retry. So transition at second consecutive fault-free scan following fault, after entering WAIT with free=0. E.g scan fault -> WAIT free=0; next free scan free=1, no retry; next free scan free=2 -> retry, Attempts++. The phrase "after a 2-scan fault-free dwell" consistent: two fault-free scans in WAIT, on second retry. In outputs same scan Run true as transition to RUNNING. Good.

Attempts output after inc. Need cap max 2. If running fault and Attempts=0 -> wait, retry -> Attempts 1, etc. Attempts=2, in WAIT retry attempt causes Attempts=3? Is it possible enter WAIT at Attempts=2? Running fault at Attempts>=2 locks, so no. But maybe stop etc. No. Still guard perhaps if Attempts <2. Requirements attempts 0..2. Could saturate.

IDLE start and fault false -> RUNNING keeping attempts. If Start true Fault true: not enter running. IDLE output run false locked false attempts same.

Need account combinational priority and outputs. We can implement single always transition. In CODESYS, case mode, nested if. Outputs computed at end from mode, Attempts. Since compiler ST. Need enum declaration likely TYPE E_Mode : (IDLE, RUNNING, WAIT, LOCKED); END_TYPE. But "Internal state: mode (IDLE/RUNNING/WAIT/LOCKED)" maybe verifier expects a variable named `mode` and enum type? Formal verifier compiles candidate to SMV maybe parses only interface? It says LTL qLocked = Spre.reference.state.mode=3, reference-only ground truth. They likely have internal instrumentation? Maybe candidate doesn't need reference mode. verify_st supplied task's spec internally? It takes assertions optionally. We don't need assert. Candidate compiled against fixed task specification likely includes reference state. Our internal mode naming may not matter. But qLocked reads reference state. Candidate observed outputs used.

We need use tools max 3 compile calls. Need first formulate robust code.

Potential semantic gotchas from formal verification: P3 validReset -> (!Run & !Locked & Attempts=0), priority 1 yes. P4 qLocked & !validReset -> Locked & !Run. Stop in locked should stay locked. Good. P5 qRunning & Fault & normal & refAttempts=2 -> Locked. normal = !validReset & !Stop. If qRunning, reset invalid and stop false, fault -> lock. Good. P6 retryDue (qWait and !Fault and free>=1) & normal -> Run & Attempts=refAttempts+1. Important: normal excludes reset and stop. But validReset requires Start false and Reset true and !Fault. retryDue has !Fault, so if Reset true Start false, priority reset yields IDLE no Run. `normal` false, no P6 obligation. If Stop true, no P6. In retry, outputs Run true attempts reference+1. Our attempts inc from candidate attempts, but P6 expects refAttempts+1. Candidate attempts supposed track reference. P8 preservation and P6 ensure. Fine.

P8: qIdle & normal & !(Start & !Fault) -> !Run & !Locked & Attempts=refAttempts. This includes qIdle with Fault true Start true etc. IDLE remains. Our yes. Idle & normal & Start & !Fault -> Run. yes. qRunning & !Fault & normal -> Run and lock false attempts preserve. yes. Note qRunning & Start etc no effect. We do.

P9: (normal & qWait & !retryDue) -> !Run & !Locked & Attempts=refAttempts. This includes qWait with Fault true (retryDue false). Our WAIT fault stays wait. It includes qWait !Fault free=0 -> increment to 1, stay wait. Good. Second clause (!qLocked & !(qRunning & Fault & normal & refAttempts=2)) -> !Locked. Need our lock only set from qRunning fault attempts>=2. But candidate Attempts and reference maybe same. Our mode locked could also be retained from pre if qLocked true, exemption. Fine. Third Run/Locked exclusion. We ensure locked means both? In valid reset from LOCKED: mode IDLE => both false. In locked state no valid reset: locked true, run false. Fine.

P7 qWait & Fault & normal -> !Run. yes.

P1 G(Fault -> !Run). Our Run matches mode after transition. Could there be RUNNING with Fault true? Only if retry transition in same scan where Fault false. Not with Fault true. Good. Run never true simultaneously fault.

P2 outputs attempts 0..2. Need ensure. Since mode logic saturates. valid reset 0. attempts increment only from retry. Potential Attempts at max 2 cannot get to wait? If fault occurs in running Attempts 2 -> locked. Stop while wait? Stop -> idle, attempts maybe 2. Start from idle with attempts 2 -> running (requirement) even though retries exhausted? Then fault -> lock. Fine. In WAIT when attempts 2 impossible except perhaps manual reset? no. Could guard anyway.

Reset priority: validReset if Reset true Fault false Start false. This clears EVEN if Stop true. Priority order says valid reset above stop. Requirement 3 "Else Stop..." confirms. Outputs false. LTL P3, yes.

Stop priority after locked latch: if already locked and stop true no valid reset, remain locked. Our if validReset else case mode locked -> locked, before checking stop. Good. If mode running stop -> idle free0 preserve attempts. If WAIT stop -> idle free0. If IDLE stop -> idle free0. P8 qIdle normal excludes stop; no requirements under stop except P4 etc. Fine.

Potential "If already LOCKED, remain LOCKED" means locked state no transitions regardless of Start/Fault/Stop; validReset exception due priority. Good.

One scan outputs are computed after transition. So if valid reset output Attempts 0 same scan. yes.

Need choose declarations. Maybe:

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task
VAR_INPUT
    Start : BOOL;
    Stop : BOOL;
    Fault : BOOL;
    Reset : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Run : BOOL;
    Locked : BOOL;
    Attempts : USINT;
END_VAR
VAR
    mode : E_Mode := E_Mode.IDLE;
    free_scans : USINT := 0;
END_VAR

Do we need include Attempts internal? It's output retained; can assign. Initial Attempts 0 by default. mode init. Need Reset handling bool expression maybe `IF Reset AND NOT Fault AND NOT Start THEN`.

Implementation:
IF Reset AND NOT Fault AND NOT Start THEN
    mode := E_Mode.IDLE;
    Attempts := 0;
    free_scans := 0;
ELSIF mode = E_Mode.LOCKED THEN
    ;  // remain. CODESYS supports empty semicolon? Could write mode := E_Mode.LOCKED;
ELSIF Stop THEN
    mode := E_Mode.IDLE;
    free_scans := 0;
ELSE
    CASE mode OF
        E_Mode.RUNNING:
            IF Fault THEN
                IF Attempts >= 2 THEN
                    mode := E_Mode.LOCKED;
                    free_scans := 0;
                ELSE
                    mode := E_Mode.WAIT;
                    free_scans := 0;
                END_IF
            END_IF
        E_Mode.WAIT:
            IF Fault THEN
                free_scans := 0;
            ELSE
                IF free_scans < 2 THEN
                    free_scans := free_scans + 1;
                END_IF
                IF free_scans >= 2 THEN
                    IF Attempts < 2 THEN
                        Attempts := Attempts + 1;
                    END_IF
                    free_scans := 0;
                    mode := E_Mode.RUNNING;
                END_IF
            END_IF
        E_Mode.IDLE:
            IF Start AND NOT Fault THEN
                mode := E_Mode.RUNNING;
            END_IF
        E_Mode.LOCKED:
            ; // unreachable due elsif
    END_CASE
END_IF

Run := (mode = E_Mode.RUNNING);
Locked := (mode = E_Mode.LOCKED);
free_scans range? On freeze? `free_scans < 2`, then increment. If pre 2 somehow remains 2 and retry. Fine.

CASE on enum. Return bool? No.

Could set mode := E_Mode.LOCKED in locked branch to be explicit. `ELSIF mode = E_Mode.LOCKED THEN mode := E_Mode.LOCKED;`. That's clean no empty statement.

Question: if `Stop` and `Fault` both true in running, priority Stop -> idle (not lock/wait). P5 normal false. P1 Run false. Attempts preserved. Good.

Need check formal verifier may expect `Attempts` output updated only and internal `attempts` separately? Requirements says Attempts internal 0..2 yet output Attempts. Likely same variable. qAttempts previous observed. LTL P6 expects O[k].Attempts. We assign after increments. Good.

Could define enum `E_Mode` as DUT with `{attribute 'qualified_only'}`? CODESYS 3.5 compiler. Simple TYPE E_Mode : (IDLE, RUNNING, WAIT, LOCKED); END_TYPE. DUT kind name. Supporting objects list required each has name, kind, declaration, implementation; functions need return_type. For DUT no implementation likely empty string. Do we need `return_type` for DUT? no. format specified. We'll output JSON final, but first test.

Need call compile_st. It takes source declaration, implementation, supporting_objects. Note compile may enforce exact expected FB_Task interface and DUT. We need include only FB declaration, no END_FUNCTION_BLOCK. Use supporting object name E_Mode. Let's compile.

Before tools, preamble.
I’ll implement the four-state retry controller, then compile and validate it with the supplied PLC tools.
